capabilities: Run Claude Code turns from an input block in a note
Stream answers and tool approval cards into the note
Attach notes, note sections and shell output as context
Fork, undo and summarize sessions with colon commands
Block writes to the session note, config folder and credentials
extras: Desktop only, Obsidian 1.11.4+; Windows untested; the plugin makes no network requests itself but Claude Code sends data to Anthropic and usage may cost money; not affiliated with Anthropic.
problem: Using Claude Code on vault notes means working in a terminal, with no in-note record of instructions, approvals and results.

relations.evidence: The plugin starts the Claude Code program that you install yourself

requires.name: Claude subscription or Anthropic API key

summary: Turns a note into a Claude Code session, writing answers, tool approvals and touched files back into the same note.
